title: wolfssl_ecdh_agree: dispatch WC_SHA384 for P-384
description: Replace hardcoded WC_SHA256 in wolfssl_ecdh_agree() with curve-aware dispatch: if ctx->curve_id == WOLFKM_ECC_P384, use WC_SHA384; else use WC_SHA256. Add comment citing SP 800-56C Rev 2 Table 2. Also add HKDF-SHA384 test vector to tests/vectors/ecdh_p384.h (IKM=ecdh_p384_shared_secret, salt=NULL, info=empty, OKM=48 bytes from Python cryptography oracle).
